comparison.objective: Place a relay beacon upright where it has line of sight to a habitat and rover; candidate commissions a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Relay task tests occlusion reasoning, transport, upright placement, and release. Candidate tests tool engagement, fine rotary adjustment, stabilization, tightening, and iterative dynamics.
comparison.success_condition: The beacon must stand on the plateau with both sight lines unobstructed; candidate must meet numeric impact and lock-retention criteria.
comparison.reason: Geometric line-of-sight placement does not test adjustment of a mechanical energy absorber.
